name: Leap Motion Controller 2

sources.title: Ultraleap products page, Leap Motion Controller 2 technical specifications
sources.covers: power, data connection, tracking range and field of view, camera frame rate, wavelength, dimensions, weight

note: An optical hand tracker. Stated: "Tracking range and field of view: Depth between 10 cm (4”) to 110 cm (43”); 160° x 160° field of view" (a cone in front of the device, not a box or cylinder, so the study's volume stays "not stated" until a measured box is entered); "Camera framerate: 115 fps maximum" (tracking_hz 115, the camera's maximum frame rate); "Operating wavelength: 850 nm" (its IR illumination can reach 850 nm depth cameras nearby); "Power supply requirement: 5VDC via USB, 500 mA"; "Data connection: USB 3.0 via USB type C connector"; "Dimensions: 84 mm x 20 mm x 12 mm" (size_mm as stated), "Weight: 29 g". Not stated: latency, accuracy.

workspace.quote: Not stated as a box or cylinder (a 160° × 160° cone from 10 to 110 cm).
